formCues: Keep body in a straight line
Load a plate or vest before setup
Lower chest to just above floor
Drive through palms to full lock-out
setup: Attach a weight vest or have a partner place a plate on your upper back, then set up in a standard high plank with hands under shoulders.

formCues: Attach weight via belt or vest
Keep rings close to torso
Lower until shoulders are below elbows
Press up while controlling ring drift
setup: Hang a dip belt loaded with weight, grip the rings, and support yourself with arms extended and rings stabilized at your sides.

formCues: Lean back to engage core
Hold weight at chest height
Rotate from the torso, not just arms
Tap weight lightly beside hip each side
setup: Sit on the floor with knees bent and heels lightly touching the ground, holding a plate or dumbbell at chest level, torso leaned back at roughly 45 degrees.
commonMistakes: Using arm swing instead of torso rotation

formCues: Hold weight against chest
Rise onto toes as you descend
Keep hips extended throughout
Lower under control to full knee flexion
setup: Stand holding onto a stable support with one hand and a weight plate against your chest, feet hip-width apart and heels rising.
commonMistakes: Bending at the hips instead of the knees

formCues: Hold plate at chest or overhead
Curl spine up vertebra by vertebra
Exhale on the way up
Control the descent back down
setup: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet anchored or flat on the floor, holding a weight plate against your chest.
commonMistakes: Using momentum instead of core control
Feet popping up off the floor

formCues: Load weight via belt or lap plate
Keep torso upright to bias triceps
Lower until elbows reach about 90 degrees
Press through palms to lockout
setup: Support yourself on parallel bars or a bench with added weight secured, arms extended and torso as vertical as possible.
commonMistakes: Leaning too far forward, shifting to chest
Dropping too deep and straining shoulders

formCues: Slide back until thighs are parallel to floor
Hold weight on lap or chest
Keep knees tracking over ankles
Press back flat against the wall
setup: Stand with back against a wall, slide down until knees are bent to about 90 degrees, and place a plate or dumbbell across your thighs.
commonMistakes: Sliding too low or too high
Holding breath instead of breathing steadily

formCues: Place hands by ears, fingers toward shoulders
Press through hands and feet evenly
Straighten arms and lift hips high
Keep knees tracking forward, not splayed
setup: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat near hips, and hands planted beside your head with fingers pointing toward your shoulders.
commonMistakes: Collapsing through the lower back instead of lifting from hips

formCues: Grip bar wider than shoulder width
Retract shoulder blades before unracking
Lower bar to upper chest
Press up in a slight arc
setup: Lie on a flat bench, grip the bar wide, and unrack it over the upper chest with feet planted firmly on the floor.
commonMistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest

formCues: Grip bar wider than shoulder width
Keep elbows pinned to sides
Curl without swinging the torso
Squeeze biceps at the top
setup: Stand holding a barbell with a wide overhand grip, arms extended and elbows close to your torso.
commonMistakes: Using body momentum to swing the weight
Not fully extending at the bottom

formCues: Grip bar well outside shoulder width
Initiate pull by depressing shoulder blades
Pull chin over the bar
Lower under control to full arm extension
setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with a wide overhand grip, arms fully extended and core braced.
commonMistakes: Not reaching full extension at the bottom
Shrugging shoulders instead of engaging lats

formCues: Place hands wider than shoulder width
Keep body in a straight line
Lower chest toward the floor
Push back up through the palms
setup: Set up in a plank position with hands placed noticeably wider than shoulder-width, fingers pointing forward.

formCues: Sit with legs spread wide
Hinge forward from the hips
Keep spine long, not rounded
Reach forward and hold the stretch
setup: Sit on the floor with legs extended wide apart and spine tall before hinging forward.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back to reach farther

formCues: Place feet wide near top of platform
Toes turned slightly outward
Lower until knees reach about 90 degrees
Press through heels to extend
setup: Sit in the leg press machine with back flat against the pad and feet set wide on the platform.
commonMistakes: Locking knees forcefully at the top
Lifting hips off the seat pad

formCues: Step into a deep lunge
Place opposite hand inside front foot
Rotate torso and reach arm toward ceiling
Keep back leg extended and active
setup: Start standing, step one foot forward into a deep lunge, and plant both hands on the floor inside the front foot.
commonMistakes: Back knee dropping to the floor

formCues: Extend arms in front of body
Rotate wrists in slow circles
Keep motion controlled, not fast
Reverse direction after several reps
setup: Stand or sit with arms extended forward and hands relaxed, ready to rotate at the wrist joint.
commonMistakes: Moving too fast to feel the joint
Limiting the circle to a small range

formCues: Extend arm in front, palm down
Use other hand to press hand downward
Keep elbow straight
Hold stretch without bouncing
setup: Extend one arm forward with palm facing down, then use the opposite hand to gently flex the wrist downward.
commonMistakes: Bending the elbow to reduce stretch intensity
Yanking instead of holding steady pressure

formCues: Extend arm in front, palm up
Use other hand to press fingers back
Keep elbow straight
Hold stretch without bouncing
setup: Extend one arm forward with palm facing up, then use the opposite hand to gently pull the fingers back toward the body.
commonMistakes: Bending the elbow to reduce stretch intensity

formCues: Hold roller with arms extended forward
Rotate wrists to wind the rope up
Keep elbows stationary
Control the unwind on the way down
setup: Hold a wrist roller device with both hands, arms extended at shoulder height, weight hanging from the attached cord.
commonMistakes: Using shoulder movement instead of wrist rotation
Gripping too loosely and losing tension

formCues: Hinge forward at roughly 45 degrees
Use an underhand grip
Pull bar toward lower abdomen
Squeeze back at the top before lowering
setup: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hinge forward to about a 45-degree torso angle with knees slightly bent.
commonMistakes: Using excessive body English to heave the bar

formCues: Brace core before lifting the yoke
Keep chest up and spine neutral
Take short controlled steps
Set the yoke down with control at the finish
setup: Position yourself under a loaded yoke frame, stand up to lift it off the rack, and settle the weight across your upper back and shoulders.
commonMistakes: Leaning too far forward under the load
Dropping the yoke instead of controlling the descent

formCues: Cradle bar in the crooks of both elbows
Keep torso upright and core braced
Walk with short, controlled steps
Avoid excessive lower back arch
setup: Clean a barbell into the crooks of your elbows, standing tall with the bar resting against your forearms and chest.
commonMistakes: Letting the bar slide down toward the wrists

formCues: Cradle sandbag in the crooks of both elbows
Keep chest up and core tight
Walk with short, deliberate steps
Breathe steadily under load
setup: Lift a sandbag and hug it into the crooks of your elbows against your chest, standing tall before beginning to walk.
commonMistakes: Letting the bag sag away from the body
Rushing the walk and losing control
